title: identity-service user event
description: Body of every message published to the identity.events exchange. Each event carries the full user snapshot; consumers apply it by version.

id.description: Stable event id; equals the AMQP message_id. Deduplicate by it.

type.description: Event type; equals the AMQP type property. The routing key is the type without the identity. prefix.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema. Consumers reject bodies with an unknown value.

occurredAt.description: When the change was recorded, UTC.

id.description: Global application user id, stable across services.

email.description: Mutable attribute, never an identity key.

active.description: false once deactivated through provisioning; sessions are revoked at that moment.

version.description: Monotonic profile version. Apply the snapshot only if this is greater than the version already applied for the user.
